Garchomp and Dragonite provide fast physical offense and setup, Rotom-Wash offers pivoting and burn support, Gholdengo handles special threats and spinblocks, Garganacl provides Salt Cure stalling and a special wall, and Annihilape gives a bulky fighting/ghost attacker that punishes passive play.</thought>

attempts.reasoning:
Build sets quickly. EVs max 32 per stat, 66 total. Items unique.

Garchomp: Rough Skin, Yache Berry or Haban? Give Leftovers? Give Garchomp Haban Berry? Standard: Stealth Rock lead with Rough Skin, Rocky Helmet not available. Give Garchomp Haban Berry, Jolly, EQ/Outrage/Stealth Rock/Scale Shot? Scale Shot lowers defense... use Swords Dance? Keep: Stealth Rock, Earthquake, Dragon Claw, Fire Blast? Fire Blast special. Use Stone Edge. Jolly 32 Atk/32 Spe/2 HP.

Dragonite: Multiscale, Dragoniteite? Mega Dragonite isn't real—Dragoninite mega stone exists in this list, so Dragonite can Mega Evolve. But unknown mega stats; safer to give Lum Berry or Weakness Policy (not listed). Give Dragonite Dragoninite? Risky. Give Lum Berry, Dragon Dance/Roost/Extreme Speed/Outrage, Adamant.

Rotom-Wash: Leftovers, Levitate, Bold: Volt Switch/Hydro Pump/Will-O-Wisp/Pain Split, 32 HP/32 Def/2 SpA.

Gholdengo: Nasty Plot, Make It Rain, Shadow Ball, Recover, Wise Glasses or Air Balloon (not listed). Give Wise Glasses, Timid 32 SpA/32 Spe/2 HP.

Garganacl: Purifying Salt, Leftovers taken—give Sitrus Berry? Give it Leftovers and Rotom Sitrus? Rotom likes Leftovers more... Garganacl needs recovery: Recover + Salt Cure. Give Garganacl Leftovers, Rotom-Wash Sitrus Berry. Garganacl: Salt Cure/Recover/Protect/Curse? Body Press with Curse. Careful nature, 32 HP/32 SpD/2 Def.

Annihilape: Leftovers gone; give it Spell Tag? Rage Fist boosted by Spell Tag. Bulk Up/Rage Fist/Drain Punch/Taunt, Careful or Adamant. Give Spell Tag, Adamant 32 HP/32 Atk/2 Spe.
